reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: It’s a great app for keeping scores but I feel that 90% of the apps glory is locked behind an expensive paywall. Honestly I will try other apps that may not be as great but the only thing that makes this app at risk of being behind is the $20 paywall for three extra things…

reviews.title: Pay to score
reviews.text: You have to pay if you want to score more than two teams. That’s fine. They have a weird “don’t delete me daddy” vibes message that pops up if you try to delete the app. I hated that.
